forbidden.name: no-domain-framework-imports
forbidden.comment: domain/ imports no rendering/storage vendor SDK (03-module-boundaries.md) — pure fixture data and pure template functions only.

forbidden.name: no-application-framework-imports
forbidden.comment: application/ defines ports and orchestrates them; it may depend on domain/, never on a concrete infrastructure adapter or vendor SDK directly (03-module-boundaries.md).

forbidden.name: no-cross-module-internals
forbidden.comment: a module may only be reached through its own root export, never by importing another module's domain/application/infrastructure directly (07-context-module-map.md)
